content.value: The Runic Altar is where consumable tomes modify eligible equipment. It has an equipment slot at the upper left, a tome slot below it, an activation button in the center, and a result slot on the right.
Craft it with one Book in the top-center crafting slot and two complete rows of Stone beneath it, for a total of one Book and six Stone.

Read the tome tooltip and confirm the item's current rarity. Different tomes require Normal, Magic, or Rare input.
Place one eligible equipment item in the upper-left slot.
Place the tome in the lower-left slot.
Press the center altar button. If the operation is legal, the original item and one tome are consumed immediately and the modified copy appears in the result slot.
Take the result from the right slot. Inspect its rarity, affix side, tier, and rolled value before performing another operation.

The input rarity does not match that tome.
The required prefix or suffix side is full.
The item already has a rune from the same duplicate group.
The tome has no definition for that equipment type.
No rune at the tome's minimum rune level is compatible with the item.
The item is a Unique, animal armour, or a tool that cannot accept affixes.
The result slot is still occupied.

A successful button press spends the inputs immediately. Taking the result only retrieves the already-created item. Alchemy, Chaos, Annulment, and a full-item Artificial craft can destroy or replace an existing rune, so read their chapters first.
